label: P2 mode
help: Choose Timed with guards for scheduled shots with a moisture ceiling and floor rescue.

label: Timed P2 interval
help: Minutes between timed shots; only used by a timed P2 mode.

label: Timed P2 shot size
help: Percent of substrate; zero uses the maintenance shot size.

label: Timed P2 first shot
help: Hours after lights-on before scheduled P2 shots can begin.

label: P2 ends before lights-off
help: Hours before lights-off to enter P3; zero keeps predictive P3.

label: Morning dryback minimum wait
help: Minimum minutes in P0; the low moisture bypass remains available.

label: P0 stall exit
help: Start P1 when reliable dryback is too slow to finish within the maximum wait.

label: EC flush target
help: Continue budgeted flush shots to this target, with a feed EC floor; zero disables.

label: Use zone P2 EC ratios
help: Use each zone dilute ratio instead of the existing 1.2 ratio.

label: P2 dilute EC ratio
help: Dilute above this multiple of the P2 EC target when zone ratios are enabled.

label: Max setpoint move per day
help: Limit automatic moisture setpoint movement in VWC points; zero removes the limit.

label: Setpoint step limit applies to
help: Choose whether the limit also applies to the AI and the learner.

label: Maximum extra ramp shots
help: Choose 1 to 30 extra ramp shots; also raise Maximum ramp shots and retain the daily cap.
